content_zh:
第一卷 重生归来 第二十章 她叫苏芮（求
苏胤他们还是第一次看到爷爷和父亲这个样子，虽然不明白这个盒子有什么问题，但是刚刚父亲说的话，他可是听得很清楚。苏家的阿璞，除了那个在他七岁就出意外失踪的小叔苏璞，还能有谁？父亲是什么意思，有小叔的下落了？难道和那个盒子有关？
苏胤看向那个盒子，盒子上涂涂画画了很多东西，看起来应该是小孩子的手笔。不过苏胤越看这个盒子越觉得眼熟，好像在哪见过似的，突然他想起来在苏老爷子的书房里也放着一个盒子，不过那个盒子要比这个大很多倍，上面的图案和这个很像。那个盒子是小叔的百宝箱，里面放着他的“宝贝”。在他小的时候小叔还特意把那些“宝贝”拿出来跟他显摆。想到这，苏胤万年面瘫的脸上也露出震惊的神色。
而一旁的苏夙也听到了自己父亲说的话，做为苏家人，他当然也知道自己有一个在十六年前意外失踪的小叔。虽然他对小叔没有什么印象，但是他知道，挂在客厅的全家福上，那个和他拥有同样一双桃花眼，风姿绰约的年轻男子就是他的小叔。
现在有小叔的消息了？一想到有小叔的消息了，他就忍不住的高兴，男人有桃花眼很没气势的，有个同病相怜的人那真是再好不过了。
苏胤爸爸所说的阿璞，陶泽西也是知道的，不过苏家小叔不是已经去世了嘛？
苏胤可能感受到了陶泽西的疑惑，便趴在陶泽西的耳边悄声说道。
“我爷爷一直不相信小叔已经去世了，后来又找周大师算了一挂，卦象显示小叔还活着，不过当时周大师被卦象反噬，还没算到小叔在哪，就吐血晕了过去。”
陶泽西看着那个盒子若有所思，苏芮，苏芮，到底和苏璞有什么关系呢。
就在陶泽西低头思考的时候，苏珣已经关，只要找到了机关，轻轻一拨就能
那个盒子是苏芮的父亲苏璞做的，原来，当年虽然他与叶蓉蓉双双失忆，但是脑海中还是会闪现出一些过去的记忆，而这个盒子就是他在苏芮三岁的时候给她做的，他不知道为什么会给自己的宝贝女儿做这样一个盒子，但是在他潜意识里，这个盒子就是他最宝贝的东西了，所以他才把他的宝贝送给自己的女儿。
苏珣放着什么。
只见盒子中放着一封信，还有一个黑黑的小木盒。
苏夙手最快，拿起那个黑黑的小木盒，
虽然苏夙现在才十八岁，但他也是京城的太子啊，什么好东西他没见过，但是这个珠子是什么东西他还真不确定，不过他看着怎么那么像传说中的夜明珠啊，要真的是夜明珠，乖乖，那可是无价之宝啊。
虽然八几年就有人说夜明珠就是萤石的一种，但是这个怎么看也不像是萤石啊，只见那珠子既有玉的白润，又带着荧光，虽然现在是白天，但是依然能让人看到它发出的光亮，一看就不是凡品。
就在苏夙琢磨这个所谓的夜明珠时，那边的苏胤等人看着苏老爷子颤抖着双手拿起那封写着苏秉之亲启的信。
“爸，这个字，小弟写得字！一定是阿璞！”苏珣看到信上的字之后提着的心终于能放下了，那就是小弟的字体啊，当初还是他每天监督苏璞练习写字，虽然苏璞每次都要讨价还价一番，但最后还是会乖乖的写完。
苏胤看着那个高大的硬汉一般的父亲，眼睛变得通红。神情十分的激动。他知道，确定是小叔没错了。
不过一旁拿着信的苏老爷子，皱了皱眉，开口道。

“不像是阿璞写得。”
“怎么会不是阿璞的字！爸！阿璞的字我最清楚了，我怎么会认错！”苏珣听到父亲否认，激动的叫了起来。
苏老爷子，看了大儿子一眼。叹息道。
“阿璞现在也应该三十五岁了吧，他的字怎么可能还是如此稚嫩。”
似是意识到自己的失误，苏珣双眼也黯淡了下来，是啊，他怎么能忘记小弟也是要长大的，他还认为小弟是那个整天黏在他身后的男孩啊。
“不对，爸爸，就算这个字不是小弟写得，那也一定是和他有关系，快拆开看看！”苏珣那本来变得黯淡的双眼，噌的一下，又恢复了神采。
苏老爷子当然也想到了这一点，所以他小心翼翼的拆开了信封。抽出其中的信纸。却不失锐利的眼中流下。
苏珣看到老父亲这个样子，也不顾父亲往日的威严，一把夺过信。当他看完整封信后，也颓然的坐在沙发上，松开了手中的信。
信纸从苏珣手中慢慢滑落，落到了陶泽西的脚边，他拿起信纸，递给了苏胤。
这时，苏老爷子突然看向陶泽西，眼神锐利，锋芒毕露。
“这盒子是谁交给你的。他现在在哪！”
从来没见过苏老爷子和苏胤父亲如此失态的样子，陶泽西不敢放肆，赶快把自己知道的一一交代。
“这是我在青木县认识的一个女孩让我送给阿胤的，我认识她的时候，是在她的父母出车祸去世时，而凶手就是章泽一，然后她找上我让我跟他一起扳倒章福民，这次我之所以能够这么快就查到章福民的犯罪证据还多亏她的帮助。”陶泽西当然不会轻易的把苏芮的奇特之处说出来，虽然对他来说苏胤不能算别人，但是他还是下意识的想要保护苏芮。
“你说的那个女孩，叫什么名字？”苏珣也开口问道。
“说来也巧，她也姓苏，叫苏芮。”
“你说什么？！她叫什么？！”苏老爷子和苏珣噌的一下站了起来。
“她叫苏芮，她…”
陶泽西睁大双眼，因为他突然想到，苏芮那死去的父亲不是就叫苏璞嘛！
－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－

Volume 1 Rebirth and Return Chapter 20 Her name is Su Rui (please
This was the first time for Su Yin and the others to see their grandfather and father like this. Although he didn't understand what was wrong with the box, he heard clearly what his father said just now. Who else could be the Su Pu of the Su family besides his uncle Su Pu who disappeared in an accident when he was seven years old? What does father mean? Is there any whereabouts of my brother-in-law? Is it related to that box?
Su Yin looked at the box. There were many things painted on the box, which seemed to be the handiwork of a child. But the more Su Yin looked at the box, the more familiar it seemed, as if he had seen it somewhere. Suddenly he remembered that there was also a box in Mr. Su's study, but that box was many times larger than this one, and the pattern on it was very similar to this one. That box is my uncle's treasure chest, which contains his "treasures". When he was young, his uncle even took out those "treasures" to show off to him. Thinking of this, Su Yin's paralyzed face showed a look of shock.
Su Su on the side also heard what his father said. As a member of the Su family, of course he also knew that he had a brother-in-law who accidentally disappeared sixteen years ago. Although he had no impression of his brother-in-law, he knew that in the family photo hanging in the living room, the charming young man with the same pair of peach blossom eyes as him was his brother-in-law.
Is there any news about your uncle now? He couldn't help but feel happy when he thought of the news about his uncle. Men with peach blossom eyes were very unattractive, so it would be great to have someone with the same problem.
Tao Zexi also knew the Apu Su Yin's father was talking about, but wasn't the Su family's uncle already dead?
Su Yin may have sensed Tao Zexi's doubts, so she whispered in Tao Zexi's ear.
"My grandfather never believed that my uncle was dead. Later, he asked Master Zhou to figure it out. The hexagrams showed that my uncle was still alive. However, Master Zhou was backlashed by the hexagrams at that time. Before he could figure out where my uncle was, he vomited blood and fainted."
Tao Zexi looked at the box thoughtfully, Su Rui, Su Rui, what does Su Rui have to do with Su Pu.
Just when Tao Zexi lowered his head to think, Su Xun had already been shut down. As long as he found the mechanism, he could easily turn it on
That box was made by Su Rui's father, Su Pu. It turned out that although he and Ye Rongrong both lost their memory back then, some past memories still flashed through their minds. He made this box for Su Rui when she was three years old. He didn't know why he made such a box for his baby daughter, but in his subconscious, this box was his most precious thing, so he gave his baby to his daughter.
What is Su Xun putting?
I saw a letter in the box and a small black wooden box.
Su Su was the quickest and picked up the small black wooden box.
Although Su Su is only eighteen years old now, he is also the prince of the capital. He has never seen anything good, but he is really not sure what this bead is, but it looks so much like the legendary night pearl. If it is really the night pearl, dear, it is a priceless treasure.
Although some people have said that the luminous pearl is a type of fluorite for more than 80 years, this one does not look like fluorite at all. The bead has the whiteness of jade and is fluorescent. Although it is daytime, people can still see the light it emits. It is not ordinary at first glance.
While Su Su was thinking about this so-called night pearl, Su Yin and others over there watched Mr. Su pick up the letter personally addressed by Su Bingzhi with trembling hands.
"Dad, this character can be written by my little brother! It must be A Pu!" Su Xun finally let go after seeing the words on the letter. It was my little brother's font. He was the one who supervised Su Pu to practice writing every day. Although Su Pu had to bargain a lot every time, he would still finish writing obediently in the end.
Su Yin looked at the tallThe eyes of the father, who looked like a big tough guy, turned red. He looked very excited. He knew that it was definitely his uncle.
But Mr. Su, who was holding the letter beside him, frowned and said.
"It doesn't look like it was written by A Pu."
"How could it not be the name of A Pu! Dad! I know the name of A Pu best, how could I admit my mistake!" Su Xun shouted excitedly when he heard his father's denial.
Mr. Su glanced at his eldest son. Sighed.
"A Pu must be thirty-five years old now. How can his handwriting still be so immature?"
As if he realized his mistake, Su Xun's eyes dimmed. Yes, how could he forget that his younger brother also had to grow up? He still thought that his younger brother was the boy who stuck behind him all day long.
"No, Dad, even if my little brother didn't write this word, it must have something to do with him. Open it and take a look!" Su Xun's eyes that had become dim suddenly regained their radiance.
Of course Mr. Su also thought of this, so he opened the envelope carefully. Pull out the letter paper. But the sharp eyes shed tears.
When Su Xun saw his old father like this, he grabbed the letter regardless of his father's former majesty. After he read the entire letter, he sat slumped on the sofa and let go of the letter in his hand.
The letter slowly slipped from Su Xun's hand and landed at Tao Zexi's feet. He picked up the letter and handed it to Su Yin.
At this time, Mr. Su suddenly looked at Tao Zexi, his eyes sharp and sharp.
"Who gave you this box? Where is he now?"
He had never seen Mr. Su and Su Yin's father acting so rude before. Tao Zexi did not dare to be presumptuous and quickly told him everything he knew.
"A girl I met in Qingmu County asked me to give this to Ayin. When I met her, her parents died in a car accident, and the murderer was Zhang Zeyi. Then she came to me and asked me to bring down Zhang Fumin with him. The reason why I wanted to do this this time We were able to find Zhang Fumin's criminal evidence so quickly thanks to her help." Of course, Tao Zexi would not tell Su Rui's peculiarities easily. Although Su Yin was not someone else to him, he still subconsciously wanted to protect Su Rui.
"What's the name of the girl you're talking about?" Su Xun also asked.
"What a coincidence, her surname is also Su, and her name is Su Rui."
"What did you say?! What's her name?!" Mr. Su and Su Xun suddenly stood up.
"Her name is Su Rui, she..."
Tao Zexi opened his eyes wide because he suddenly thought, wasn't Su Rui's dead father named Su Pu?
